clusters.title: [Feature Request] Add ability to enable/disable MCPs at tool level and MCP server level
clusters.summary: ## Summary Currently there is no way to toggle individual MCP tools or entire MCP servers on/off. It would be useful to add enable/disable functionality at both levels: - **MCP server level**: allow enabling or disabling an entire MCP server, so all of its tools can be turned off
